title: world: 1B coins, 30% in the pool, quorum(spend)=3% of the voting base
the hop wallets were never enrolled (their scan weight is 0) → they cannot vote
wallet hopping between two owner snapshot transactions (the owner posts the weights of ONE scan): 200M real coins voted three times
note: counted for=200M vs against=210M (A really owns 200M; honest tally 200M vs 210M = REJECTED); posting weight 0 for the hop wallets → NoWeight (true/true); executed=false

title: RESIDUAL: the owner posts LIVE balances one by one instead of the weights of one scan → the same hop still counts 200M three times
note: counted for=600M vs against=210M (real 200M vs 210M → should be REJECTED); executed=true. Needs an owner who ignores the scan-based tools (site: «Внести всем (один скан)», scripts/snapshot_all.ts)

title: control: without hopping the same 200M-vs-210M vote is REJECTED (so the hop is what flipped A2.1r)
stale scan: the coins left the wallet before the owner posted its weight → the weight is refused
after open_voting no further voter can be enrolled (so the owner has to enrol everybody first)
electorate lock-out: the first enrolled voter tries to vote at once → VotingNotOpen; D (15%) and B (6%) can still be enrolled
note: early vote accepted=false; proposal (0.5 SOL out of the treasury) executed=false

title: control: with the whole electorate enrolled first, the 200M-vs-210M vote is REJECTED
buy → owner snapshots → sell everything → still votes with the full weight
note: weight counted=60M coins (6.06% of supply) while he holds 0.249 coins afterwards. Cost of renting them = 0.7780 SOL (9.7% of the 8 SOL he spent buying; both 5% fees + slippage)

title: quorum veto: after the vote passed, a trader BUYS coins out of the pool (the live base grows past the vote's quorum)
note: voter had 21100000 coins vs quorum 21000000 (margin 0.5%); the attacker pulled 4675960 coins (0.67% of the base) out of the pool, live base 700000000 → 704675960; the buys cost him 0.0467 SOL; execute with the frozen base: ok=true

title: quorum push: proposal is 0.05M coins short; a holder SELLS 3M coins into the pool → the live base shrinks
note: short of quorum before=true; the pre-v4.1 live rule WOULD be met after the dump=true; with the frozen base executed=false

title: measurement: the frozen base is the base AT the moment of open_voting (a trade just before it counts, a trade after it does not)
note: base 697000000 → 699403518 after a buy before the opening; frozen at open=699403518; a second buy after the opening moved the live base to 701769204 but the frozen base stays 699403518. The owner can look at the pool right before pressing «Начать голосование»; a trader would have to hit the same block, and pays the 5% fee on the volume

title: create a proposal with coins that are sold right afterwards (threshold is checked on the LIVE balance)
note: created=true ; holds 0.777 coins afterwards; total cost incl. rent and both 5% fees=0.1963 SOL. Creating a proposal executes nothing: it still needs the owner's enrolment and a majority
